_comment: Shared baseline compiler options for every ExoJS package. Package-local configs add rootDir/outDir/include/exclude, customConditions (package-specific source condition), and any package-specific lib/types/paths. Strict type-safety flags including noUncheckedIndexedAccess and exactOptionalPropertyTypes are enabled below. Measured and deliberately NOT enabled, with the count that decided it: allowUnreachableCode:false (2) flags the `return` after an `assert(false, ...)` guard, which is unreachable only until the assertion is stripped from a production build - the return is what keeps that path defined; noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature (554) is almost entirely the serialization layer reading its own field records, where bracket notation carries no extra safety; erasableSyntaxOnly (109) is the runtime `enum` declarations and constructor parameter properties, neither of which has an erasable spelling with the same semantics; isolatedDeclarations (620) would require an explicit annotation on every inferred public return type. module:Preserve and skipLibCheck:false are open questions, not rejections.
